sections.heading: History
sections.text:
In the past, Dr. Rickman fought the younger Dante Vale on a clifftop in Jericho, Palestine for an ancient native Mexican bowl. He won the altercation by using his powerful Titan Wendigo and provoking Dante by taunting him into a fight. He then mocked Dante for his hot-headed nature, a memory which stuck with him for years. [Mission to Skara Brae] 

Rickman came face to face with Dante many years later in the village of Skara Brae, on a mission to uncover the secret behind the ancient Jadeite Necklace, a mission given to him by The Professor himself. He pursued the team and fought against Zhalia Moon and her King Basilisk before sending Gregor, his new addition to his team, to eliminate the Huntik team .[Mission to Skara Brae]

Rickman later sent his agents, Celina and Bonnie to pursue Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill but they failed. Later, Rickman invoked Silver Hunter in to attack Dante in Quimper Cathedral. After defeating Dante's Solwing, it fought against Caliban who was sent back to his Amulet by Rickman's spell. Silver Hunter knocked Dante to the floor but was turned to stone by King Basilisk before he could finish him off. Rickman later arrived at Ys with back up from his team and Captain Caine. [The Seekers of Ys] 

Rickman summoned Silver Hunter in the underwater city of Ys, to hunt down Dante, but it was defeated by Dante's Metagolem. He then invoke Wendigo, reminding Dante of how he first beat him, but he was knocked unconscious by Dante and arrested by the Huntik Foundation along with Celina, Bonnie, Gregor, Captain Caine and Ford. [The Lost City of Casterwill]

He pursued the team and fought against Zhalia Moon and her King Basilisk before sending Gregor, his new addition to his team, to eliminate the Huntik team .[Mission to Skara Brae]

He then invoke Wendigo, reminding Dante of how he first beat him, but he was knocked unconscious by Dante and arrested by the Huntik Foundation along with Celina, Bonnie, Gregor, Captain Caine and Ford. [The Lost City of Casterwill]

==Abilities==
Dr. Rickman is an extremely astute Seeker who is able to outsmart opponents by sening their insecurities and weaknesses. He is extremely expeirenced, and can sense magical properties such Thoughtspecter illusions. His combat abilities were able to overpower those of Dante's showing him to be a formidable and powerful enemy.

=== Spells Utilize ===
*Acidheart
*Augerfrost
*Hopeshatter
*Raypulse
*Slipstream
*Touchram
*Venomhand

=== Bonded Titans ===
*Silver Hunter
*Wendigo
